items.title: Monkey Play
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Planet of the monkeys offers so much fun. This skin pack is based on cute monkey breeds from all over the world. You'll know how to conduct your business with these skins!

- 10 skins with a variety of modern-day jobs (for both boys and girls!)
- Bananas not included!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from PSB.

items.title: Lucky Block Town
items.creator: Norvale
items.description:
Lucky Block Town is an exciting map for a lot of fun experiences. Throughout the map, lucky blocks have been spread for you and your friends to break! Test your luck, and get either pleasant or unlucky surprises!

+ 150+ possible drops! 
+ 20+ possible structure outcomes! 
+ 5 matching skins! 

By Artifact Studios and Norvale

items.title: Cool Woods
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Here come the Cool Woods! Try not to be near the fire! Or even craft them. They don't like that!

- Twelve Cool Woods.
- One skin totally free.
- By DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Glitch Teens
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Your team is now glitched; at least in appearance. Enjoy this cool pack of skins based on a computer glitch.

- Eight skins.
- One skin totally free.
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Grunge Core
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
You've heard of Cottage Core, now get ready for Grunge Core!
Enter the dark side of Cottage Core, where everything is dark and scarier. Only cute and adorable in the slightest bit, these outfits will make you look like you're ready to rule the world.

- 8 scary skins
- 1 FREE skin: Jade

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Parkour City 2
items.creator: Tetrascape
items.description:
Play through this fun parkour by yourself or with friends! Collect coins and get to the finish line as fast as possible to get a high score.
Created by Tetrascape

items.title: Acrylic Pours 3
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Acrylic pouring is a beautiful technique where you mix colors and create accidental masterpieces! It's amazing fun and fills you with creativity you didn't know you had! These skins were created with the same kind of technique and are each beautiful masterpieces of their own.

- 38 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Claws
items.creator: The World Foundry
items.description: Be a sharp clawed cat in these high definition colorful animal outfits. Suitable for all ages!

items.title: Smaller Self
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Go on an adventure while carring around a tinier copy of yourself on your head! But be careful not to drop it...

- 10 super funny Smaller Self skins!
- Make all of your friends laugh!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Scary Skins
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Choose any of these scary skins for your next Minecraft adventure.

- Horror
- Spooky
- Great for roleplay

by: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: MONSTERS++
items.creator: Spark Universe
items.description: Fight OVER 20 NEW MONSTERS. Play SURVIVAL or take the fight to the MONSTER ARENA.
items.changelog:
- Updated to Minecraft 26.2
- Added Vibrant Visuals support

items.title: Ninjas vs Zombies
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Deep in the forest lies a battle as old as time, the battle between Ninjas and Zombies! Who will win? Who will survive? It's up to YOU to decide! Will you be the shadow in the night, or fear itself?

- 12 skins!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Dragon Warriors
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Become the mightiest of Dragon Warriors and fight to no end! Rule your city or dominate in PvP with these warriors! Maybe you'll find yourself in the depths of the End, fighting the ender dragon!

- 12 dragon rider themed skins!
- 2 cloaked masked skins!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Space Teens
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Join the space teens on a trip around the galaxy!

+ 12 space teens, preparing for many great adventures together!
+ 1 FREE skin included!

items.title: Derpy Eyes
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
The funniest and derpiest teen skins are finally here!
With their hilarious sided eyes and teen looks, these skins are bringing the perfect mix for a fun time with friends.

+ 12 derpy eyed teens, spreading the fun and joy on all your worlds!
+ Enjoy this funny look and prank your friends.
+ 1 FREE skin included!

items.title: Modern Anime Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Cute anime teen fashion is right here! Stroll through a modern city in style with these perfect anime teen skins. Watch all the anime your heart desires and play your favorite game modes like skyblock and parkour with these awesome skins.

- Cute and cool designs
- Colorful
- Perfect for teens and roleplay

items.title: Minigame Mashup
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
100 minigames! Play with up to 8 players at once! Grab your friends and see who can beat these miniature quests the fastest. With 100 minigames and technology making sure you always play a new game is maximum fun!

- Multiplayer friendly
- Play with 2 - 8 players
- Fun minigames await!

items.title: Alien Empire
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
You believe there are aliens among us? Welcome to Alien Empire! Experience surviving on a whole new planet among extraterrestrial civilization. Sit in the UFO and fly around the town. Find hiding places and secret underground bases in an out of this world experience!

- 2 alien skins!
- Unprecedented UFO in Minecraft!
- By Withercore

items.title: Colorful Animals
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Pink, yellow or purple... Which color is your favorite? Whichever color you like, you'll love the skins in this pack! Now is the time to have a colorful and cute animal skin with our newest skin pack!

+ 12 skins (1 FREE!)
+ By Mirevon Studios

items.title: Egypt City Life
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
Travel back in time to ancient Egypt and explore the historical city life. Ride a camel through the desert or hunt for secret treasures in pyramids. Explore secret bases, tunnels and temples of the pharaoh. Watch out for snakes and scorpions! 

+ Special ridable mobs: camel, snake and scorpion
+ Find treasures hidden on the map
+ Roleplay
+ Free skin

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Punksaurs
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
These dinosaurs city teens are even cooler as punk rockers!
* 21 role-playing skins!

items.title: Fresh Hoodz
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
These city teens are trendy and ready for some high school roleplay! 
* 30 awesome characters!

items.title: Too Cool Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Better than the rest? Then show it off! These teens are too cool to handle! 

*16 cool teens
*2 free skins

items.title: Wild West
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Giddy up, partner! Grab your stetson and lasso, and saddle up. It's time to visit the Wild West!

*12 wild west skins
*2 free skins
